result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, featuring a multi-lane roadway under a bridge with no formal sidewalks or marked crossings. Pedestrians are forced onto unpaved dirt paths, and visibility is significantly compromised by large bridge supports and shadows.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Facilities
hazards.description: There is no paved sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk on uneven dirt paths or in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway under the bridge

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Large concrete bridge pillars create significant blind spots for both drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the image where the bridge supports meet the ground

hazards.name: Poor Lighting and Shadows
hazards.description: The underpass creates deep shadows that reduce the visibility of pedestrians to oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Area directly beneath the bridge structure

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, paved sidewalk separated from the roadway to provide a safe walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-intensity LED lighting under the bridge to eliminate shadows and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk and Signage
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate pedestrian warning signs.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked crosswalk and traffic signals but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and a continuous sidewalk network on both sides. High-speed traffic (40 mph) and sightline obstructions from parked vehicles increase risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: A parked truck near the crosswalk on the right side blocks visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Missing sidewalk
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a paved sidewalk, leaving pedestrians without a safe path after crossing.

hazards.name: High speed limit
hazards.description: The posted speed limit of 40 mph is high for an area with commercial activity and pedestrian crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: Sign on the right and left poles

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide dedicated crossing phases.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a continuous pedestrian network.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban street with mixed-use buildings that lacks essential pedestrian crossing infrastructure at a signalized intersection. While sidewalks are present, there are no marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or curb ramps visible, creating a high-exposure environment for people crossing the street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection is controlled by a traffic light but lacks any painted crosswalks, making pedestrian movements unpredictable for drivers.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The roadway is excessively wide without a median or refuge, increasing the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The environment features a marked zebra crosswalk across a two-lane roadway, bordered by a sidewalk and mature trees. While basic infrastructure exists, the crossing is uncontrolled and sightlines are partially obstructed by an embankment and large trees on the corner.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree and a grassy embankment on the right side of the image may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground corner near the crosswalk entrance

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks any signalization or signage to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center left, across the main roadway

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver yielding rates at this uncontrolled crossing.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Ensure the area immediately preceding the crosswalk is kept clear of any parking or tall vegetation to maintain clear sightlines.
